title: The Dream Rift · The Retreat
dek: A breach opens onto a dead titan and a living dream feeding on its weapon. The expedition is overwhelmed and leaves the tear unsealed.

facts.Recorded dates: Source posts · 31 March 2025 · in-world date unresolved
facts.People: Expedition participants; names not recovered in this summary

sources: #rifts — existing public account; original qualifications retained
#the-void — existing public account; original qualifications retained
body:
A doorway opens in the sky across the realm, interrupting an ordinary cloudy day. Those who answer do so without knowing the threat beyond it. Entering carries them through a dreamscape of dead ideas, abandoned possibilities and glimpses that resemble their own dreams.

The weapon beyond the threshold

The travelers find one another near a vast dead creature. Its body looks less like a warrior slain in combat than something consumed as food. Its fallen sword hangs in the strange space, and acolytes and a living dream are harvesting power from it.

The narration connects the feeding with the hole between realities. As the company looks toward the weapon, the creature eating at that opening turns toward them. The expedition has a threat to stop, but little assurance about the world in which it must fight.

Hunger and fear

The battle attacks perception as well as flesh. Struck travelers see nightmares that frighten or paralyze them. One fallen adventurer is seized and crushed by a creature of hunger. A mental attack fails against seers described as mindless, intent on their feeding and their task.

These details make the defeat more than a tally of enemies left standing. The company is losing the ability to act coherently in a place where it already cannot reliably distinguish dream from reality.

The failed attempt

The closing narration explicitly describes the party as overwhelmed and the attempt to seal the rift as a failure. Their remaining connection to their own reality gives them a way to escape. Leaving is the outcome, rather than a completed victory hidden inside a retreat.

The breach is not fully sealed. The final account warns of ripples and nightmares beyond the company’s knowledge and describes the day as a victory for Death. That warning remains a consequence announced in the scene; it does not identify every later nightmare as an effect of this particular opening.

What the survivors can carry home

They have seen a dead titan-scale being, its weapon exploited, and a living dream feeding the breach. They have also learned that merely entering together does not guarantee they can finish the work.

The destination’s exact nature, the complete casualty record and the later fate of the opening remain incomplete. Its source date is preserved as a posting date. It must not be given the safe-return assumptions or successful closure of another rift encounter.
